title: File storage
uploadHint: Click or drag files here to upload. You can select several files at once.
uploadTypeHint: Images, PDF, Office documents, text, archives, audio and video are supported. The server also checks that the content matches the extension.
uploadLimitHint: The size limit per file is set on the server (50 MB by default). You will see the reason if a file is too large.
uploadFailedUnknown: Check your network or the file size and try again.

config.title: Storage settings
config.configKeyHelp: Each uploaded file records the key of its storage. Do not change the key of a storage that already has files.
config.keyKeepPlaceholder: Already set. Leave blank to keep it.
config.keyEmptyPlaceholder: Not set. Leave blank if not needed.
config.keyHelp: Saved keys are never shown, for security.
config.used: Switched to "{name}". New uploads will be stored here.
config.confirmUse: Switch to "{name}"? New uploads will be stored here. Existing files are not affected.
